source.name: 433FC: Saudi Pro League 2026/27 Shirt Sponsors: Every Club's Main Sponsor & Kit Maker
source.note: The article's 2026/27 club-by-club table lists Al-Shabab with main shirt sponsor Jetour and kit maker Offside, and says many SPL deals are multi-year contracts signed in 2023-2025 that carry directly into 2026/27. The club announced Jetour as a strategic sponsor on 2025-08-28 (X) and a main-sponsor contract to the end of 2025-26 (alshabab-sc.sa/blogs/792); no 2026-27 renewal announcement was found.

source.name: Saudi Pro League – Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL
source.note: Official league gallery of the 2026-27 kits; the 'Al Shabab Home 26-27' photo shows the Tameeni (تأميني) patch on the right chest of the striped home shirt (image viewed 2026-10-03). Placement listed 'front' to match the league-wide upper-chest Tameeni position on the other 2026-27 kits in this dataset.

source.name: Footy Headlines – Al Shabab 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: Saudi Pro League side Al Shabab has officially revealed its new home and away kits for the 26-27 season, manufactured by local brand Offside.
source.note: Kit launch coverage; the article's launch photos show the Offside maker mark, the Tameeni chest patch and the RSL sleeve patch. Offside is also the kit manufacturer named for Al-Shabab in 433FC's 2026/27 table, and the club site links its store to offsideksa.com.

summary: Offside home kit (black-and-white stripes, launched 2026-08-13). Front: Jetour (per 433FC's 2026/27 list; the club's own Jetour announcements cover up to 2025-26) and the Tameeni chest patch (visible in the SPL's official kit photo); kit maker Offside. Theeb (chest sponsor in 2024-25 and 2025-26), Mezaj (back in previous listings) and Direct for Travel (sleeve in previous listings) had no 2026-27 placement evidence and were removed pending sources - see the pull request.
